svg.aria-label: Timeline of the shutdown in the smoke test. At time zero the node closing rounds exits while it still holds the claim on the next round. A follower waits 150 seconds without a record, takes over, then meets the slow node's unreleased lease, which it had not tracked, and trusts it for another 120 seconds. A learner waiting in close() for its final round reaches its 270-second timeout and gives up; the round commits seconds later.
svg.text: Stopping the run: 150 s, then 120 s, against a 270 s timeout
The learner waiting in close() gave up seconds before its final round committed.
exits, still holding the claim on the next round
the slow node's lease, new to it: 120 s
waits for its final round to commit
Fixed: close() releases its lease even when it must cancel a publish, and followers track leases on every poll
and keep those observations when they take over, so an old lease gets no fresh waiting period.
